rules.executor_scope: public GitHub-hosted CPU except explicitly authorized sealed private research lane
rules.source_rights: separate software code license from data and derivative rights
rules.privacy: no identities, private data, third-party model/motion mirrors or CPE sealed state in public

reference_gates.scope: original synthetic two-engine IK goal-distance gate only
official glTF Validator on five original GLBs; warnings remain actionable

phases.name: Authority, contracts and rights
phases.exit: Machine-checked WBS, evidence schema, source-rights gate, 3-audience contract

phases.name: Independent standards and engine qualification
phases.exit: Independent specs gate and 3 MMD-capable engine observations; no assumed native MMD truth

phases.name: Interchange, rigging and composition
phases.exit: Morphs, multi-species retarget, USD, time-varying source states and synthetic interactive scene

phases.name: Experiment design, evidence and three-audience operations
phases.exit: Go-driven experiment matrix, provenance, human reports, automation CLI, agent-readable state

tasks.title: Machine-readable workplan, DAG and readiness validator
tasks.action: Version the roadmap JSON, Go validator, dependency-cycle checks, status semantics and CLI workflow.
tasks.acceptance: Go tests + public $0 GHA clean checkout both pass; malformed DAG/status cases rejected; -json output stable.
tasks.evidence: git path + exact workflow run and native logs; no task DONE without verified run.

tasks.title: Go Evidence/Fixture/SourceSemantics typed v1 contract
tasks.action: Reuse JSON Schema, PROV-O and RO-Crate primitives for source time/axes/units/kinematics/rights; minimal Go envelopes; never rewrite glTF.
tasks.acceptance: Go roundtrip + property tests reject missing units/time origin/rights/sources, unknown status not promoted.
tasks.evidence: Schema version, golden JSON, negative tests, data dictionary.

tasks.title: Khronos skinned-mesh-root warning interoperability experiment
tasks.action: Open exact original G7/G9 Blender GLBs in separate glTF viewers and roundtrip through Blender; compare scene hierarchy, actual mesh deformation and warning semantics.
tasks.acceptance: Demonstrate either observable independent-reader defect or classify no-impact with explicit caveats; retain validator warnings; no auto-suppress.
tasks.evidence: Two readers + binary/source receipts + exact warning codes/frames.

tasks.title: Pin and smoke-test babylon-mmd genuine third engine
tasks.action: Source/licence audit, determine Node/headless/Canvas/WASM requirements, smoke with original PMX/VMD only. No packaged demo characters.
tasks.acceptance: Pinned commit and license, real public runner execution with source rig data, capabilities UNKNOWN where unsupported.
tasks.evidence: Native action log, exact SHA, run, tool/source rights ledger.

tasks.title: Three-engine evaluation of G7/G9/G10
tasks.action: Compare full source VMD time, hierarchy, morph channels and goal transforms among Blender, direct MMD converter and Babylon.
tasks.acceptance: All three independently observed or NOT_TESTED with exact reason; no inferred native MMD equality; diagnostics at 0/15/30 and whole 31 frames.
tasks.evidence: Per-engine samples, failure matrix, sources, SHA and objective tolerances.

tasks.title: Metamorphic and adversarial invariants
tasks.action: Original seed fixtures with transform equivariance, scale-normalized errors, bone/root rename, temporal shifts, IK toggle and deliberate broken weights/targets.
tasks.acceptance: Positive invariants pass and each injected semantic defect is detected with a mutation-kill score; no false PASS for NOT_TESTED.
tasks.evidence: Seed/fixture hash, pre/post states, failures, mutation score and independent reference.

tasks.title: Khronos generated validation corpus for glTF
tasks.action: Pin glTF-Asset-Generator fixtures; catalog rights and use Khronos Validator as standards oracle, not custom spec duplication.
tasks.acceptance: Positive and invalid generated cases handled as expected; warnings reported separately; no external character assets.
tasks.evidence: Validator raw JSON and source corpus manifest/hash.

tasks.title: Canonical EngineObservation + FK/IK math oracle
tasks.action: Define coordinate-frame graph, quaternion convention, sample clock, actual evaluated skin geometry; compare against Pinocchio or trusted independent math implementation.
tasks.acceptance: Full 31-sample source time and world joint/skin trajectories reproducible; discrepancy tests expose conjugation/axis bugs.
tasks.evidence: Typed Go engine observation, FK unit tests, exact transform basis, independent check.

tasks.title: Cross-engine full-trajectory parity and solver stability
tasks.action: Measure joint angles/velocity/acceleration, skin drift, IK solver iterations and timeout/stability with aligned source samples.
tasks.acceptance: Pairwise trajectories checked with predeclared tolerances across normal/extreme cases; goal accuracy not substituted for pose parity.
tasks.evidence: Time-series report and failure heat map per segment/engine.

tasks.title: Foot planting/contact semantics and motion-quality metrics
tasks.action: Original stance/swing/landing/stair cases; Kimodo-like foot skating, penetration, support polygon, constraint error and provenance of contact labels.
tasks.acceptance: Explicit contact ground truth, slip speed, penetration, and target error measured individually in SI/source units; threshold justified.
tasks.evidence: Contact interval labels, movement traces, ground coordinates, adversarial control.

tasks.title: Physics/cloth/hair and solver-integrator matrix
tasks.action: Pin step rate, substeps, Bullet/Ammo or MMD physics oracle, original spring/rigidbody/cloth samples. Never conflate visual match with dynamics.
tasks.acceptance: Determinism/repeatability under fixed seed, quantified energy/contact errors or NOT_TESTED; no license-uncleared demo.
tasks.evidence: Solver inputs/versions/timestep + numeric trajectories/render evidence.

tasks.title: MMD morph and material semantic loss matrix
tasks.action: Original PMX group/bone/UV/material morphs, alpha/toon/texture edge cases, VMD face sequences, test glTF/USD representability.
tasks.acceptance: Every morph kind classed preserved/approximated/lost and visual vs editable action tested independently.
tasks.evidence: Raw PMX offsets, evaluated mesh/material samples, comparison receipts.

tasks.title: Rig retarget and species/mechanical joint archetypes
tasks.action: Prior-art MMD VMD Sizing and Rigify/BVH/VRM adapters; source semantics for human, quadruped, articulated vehicle/robot; no real identities in public.
tasks.acceptance: Distinct rig graphs and mapped joints with motion/ground/contact checks; source-to-target map and loss metrics.
tasks.evidence: Source/target rig map, model/time state rights, comparator traces.

tasks.title: OpenUSD/UsdSkel editability and interchange
tasks.action: Export/import original skeletal joint and blend shape into USD and glTF, preserve native PMX semantic extras separately.
tasks.acceptance: USD and glTF roundtrips compare hierarchy, weight/morph, editable state and animations with declared missing semantics.
tasks.evidence: USD/GLB/BLEND files, validator and loss manifest.

tasks.title: Rights gate, provenance and long-lived proof bundles
tasks.action: Extend existing Go catalog rights dimensions separately for tools, datasets, model, motion, music, derivative and publish; RO-Crate/PROV-O evidence; 14-day artifact expiry handled via regeneration.
tasks.acceptance: Missing view/train/modify/redistribute rights fail closed for public outputs; proofs link SHA+runner+input; no uploaded third-party asset.
tasks.evidence: Go catalog tests, policy decision receipts, provenance manifest and artifact regen recipe.

tasks.title: Design-of-experiments and model/actor interview qualification
tasks.action: Factorized engine x fixture x feature x platform x seed, substitution matrix, fixed compute budgets, randomized/paired comparisons, coverage and ablation.
tasks.acceptance: No cherry-picking; every model/tool decision has sample size, held-out split, variance, cost and counterexamples; CPU/GPU/TPU/MLX roles distinct.
tasks.evidence: Machine-readable run matrix, model version, score distribution and ablation.

tasks.title: Three-audience UI / UX / DX and control-plane state
tasks.action: Keep one Go JSON canonical state, Markdown/human artifact report, CLI and agent APIs; explicit admissions/assignments/targets; discover/observe/plan/apply/verify.
tasks.acceptance: Human can see why an item passed/failed/blocked; CLI reproduces it; agent can inspect and request candidate only; no audience bypasses gates.
tasks.evidence: Snapshot/report, CLI tests, accessibility and idempotent state transitions.

tasks.title: Rights-clean end-to-end interactive synthetic scene
tasks.action: Compose original motion/rig/morph/physics/tested interchange into scene with controllable joints and editable output; external identities handled by distinct private workcell.
tasks.acceptance: At least two animation categories and two controllable modalities, reproducible source + GLB/USD/BLEND + iOS-readable preview; no unsupported realism claims.
tasks.evidence: Scenario manifest, portable scene, source, video, time-series and proof.

tasks.title: Blinded Track B CPE/concept-search-adapters/SearXNG run
tasks.action: Verify authorized CPE snapshot/access and launch two independent, blinded queries from frozen native-language seeds; no Track A leakage.
tasks.acceptance: Actual 12-question budgeted independent raw result sets sealed with provenance; zero findings not interpreted as concepts absent.
tasks.evidence: CPE snapshot SHA and SearXNG engine configs/raw traces.
tasks.blocker: Authorized connected CPE/search-adapters executor and pre-sweep snapshot not available; do not call a direct web sweep Track B.

tasks.title: Independent bilingual evidence reconciliation and CPE proposals
tasks.action: Compare tracks with source ancestry dedupe, false friend detection, negative controls, independent adjudication and policy separation.
tasks.acceptance: Coverage/precision/disagreement per language and concept, proposals remain candidates pending authorized CPE policy decision.
tasks.evidence: Signed comparison report and candidate-only change proposal.
tasks.blocker: Requires completed sealed W19 and authorized CPE proposal workflow.

tasks.title: Bounded repeatability and no-cost runner qualification
tasks.action: Refine workflow triggers, dependency pins, SHA verification, cache diagnostics, job timeouts, artifact expiry and admission budgets; maintain public/private isolation.
tasks.acceptance: Public checkout produces consistent baseline, bounded CPU minutes and no credential/third-party content leakage.
tasks.evidence: Exact run/commit/runtimes plus cost and provenance receipts.
